title: Help
description: content/help.json: the words behind every "?" button, every long-press and the join line on the shared screen (#256). Mirrors packages/shared/src/help.ts HelpContent; where the two disagree, the TypeScript type wins. Written for a child of eight listening to it read aloud: one or two short sentences, US spelling, no em dashes.

surfaces.description: One entry for every player surface (HELP_SURFACE_IDS).

things.description: What kind of thing a long-press landed on (HELP_THING_KINDS). A thing's own words, where it has them, are shown first.

join.description: The one line under the room code and QR. It must be true of a four-letter room and a six-letter visitor room, so it never counts letters.

icon.description: An icon id from the shared icon set.
